bridge_response.rationale: The hypothesis is now supported by an observed config mechanism plus a matching service symptom and a downstream effect, drawn from two independent source types. incident_2001-E-004 (configs, service backend, observed_at 2026-10-01T12:00:10Z) is the retrieved diff for change_id runtime-1 and states concrete parameter modifications: db_pool_max 20 -> 2 with concurrency=120, a reduced connection pool capable of raising backend latency and error rates. incident_2001-E-003 (changes, backend, 2026-10-01T12:00:10Z) records the same change occurrence. The configured service backend then shows a coincident matching symptom: incident_2001-E-005 (metrics, backend, 2026-10-01T12:00:10Z) reports pool_waiters=118 requests, a connection-pool wait signal aligned with the reduced db_pool_max. The only diverging node downstream is incident_2001-E-009 (metrics, gateway, 2026-10-01T12:00:14Z, http_5xx_rate=0.35), which by the observed topology edges -- gateway -> backend (incident_2001-T-gateway) and backend -> {postgres, redis, payment} (incident_2001-T-backend) -- is downstream of backend, and its 12:00:14Z timestamp is four seconds after the 12:00:10Z change and pool_waiters reading. The configs-source diff and the metrics-source symptom are independent sources, and the cause discriminator is the pool-parameter modification followed by the pool_waiters rise on the configured service ahead of the downstream gateway 5xx: a resource-saturation account without a preceding configuration change is displaced by this chronology. incident_2001-E-001 (backend request_latency_ms=40 ms at 12:00:00Z) is a pre-change baseline and does not contradict the mechanism. No shared observation conflicts with the hypothesis. Backend error-rate telemetry, higher-resolution latency series, leaf-service health, percentiles, and change-chronology completeness are optional corroboration, not blocking causal gaps, because a config mechanism followed by matching service symptoms is sufficient and missing unrelated telemetry is not a causal contradiction. The blocking gaps flagged in the prior round -- the unretrieved runtime-1 diff and the unobserved matching backend symptom -- have both been resolved in this round, so requested_checks and contradictions are empty.
